snippet.title: Primal Carnage: Evolution | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Primal Carnage roars back onto PlayStation with Primal Carnage: Evolution - dino vs human mayhem remastered! Available MAY 28TH 2026.

WISHLIST NOW: 
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10002488/

A massively expanded experience, featuring evolved gameplay alongside lovingly remastered visuals and sound. Packed with new features and mechanics, plus a huge collection of unlockable items, Primal Carnage: Evolution is ferocious prehistoric warfare taken to the next level!

Hunt humans, slay dinosaurs!
https://www.primalcarnage.com
